name: smooth-corners
title: Smooth Corners
description: Smooth (squircle) corners for any element: a clip-path from four corner curves, with SVG borders and shadows that follow the shape.
label: Lisse
author: Jace Attard <https://github.com/JaceThings>

props.name: corners
props.description: Uniform `{ radius, smoothing?, curve?, exponent?, preserveSmoothing? }`, or per corner: `topLeft`, `topRight`, `bottomRight`, `bottomLeft`, or the logical `topStart`, `topEnd`, `bottomStart`, `bottomEnd` (a number is a radius). Curves: `squircle` (default), `arc`, `superellipse`, `clothoid`.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render; other props are typed against it.

props.name: asChild
props.description: Merge onto the single child element instead of rendering one (`as` is ignored).

props.name: innerBorder / outerBorder / middleBorder
props.description: An SVG border inside, outside or centred on the edge: `{ width, color, opacity, style? }`; `color` may be a linear or radial gradient; styles solid, dashed, dotted, double, groove, ridge.

props.name: shadow / innerShadow
props.description: Drop and inner shadows that follow the shape: `{ offsetX, offsetY, blur, spread, color, opacity }`.

props.name: autoEffects
props.description: Turn the element's CSS `border` and `box-shadow` into the matching SVG effects (they would otherwise be clipped).

props.name: shadowStrategy
props.description: `box-shadow` draws the shadow as a rounded-rectangle CSS shadow on a sibling, avoiding an SVG filter rasterisation bug in WebKit.

a11y: Purely presentational: the clip-path and the SVG overlays add no roles, and every overlay is aria-hidden with pointer events off. Semantics come from `as` or the `asChild` child.

clip-path also clips focus outlines: give a focusable element an inset focus ring (`focus-visible:ring-inset`), or draw the ring as an `outerBorder` while focused (the useSmoothCorners pattern in the docs).
Right to left: logical corner names (`topStart`, ...) follow the element's computed direction; upstream's physical names are unchanged.

Forced colors: backgrounds become the system Canvas color, so a shape whose edge is only a background change disappears against the page. The SVG border effects keep their colors (measured in Chromium with forced colors on), so give such surfaces an `innerBorder` or `outerBorder`, or a CSS border (converted by `autoEffects`).
No motion of its own; the demo's sweep stops under reduced motion and has a Pause control.
usage: <SmoothCorners corners={{ radius: 20, smoothing: 0.6 }} className="bg-card p-6">Hello, squircle</SmoothCorners>
